summary: Frontend-only E2E validation of Kodama Talk (Vite + React 19 + TanStack Router). Exercised the 13 flows requested by main agent against the public preview URL with a real Chromium browser and prefers-reduced-motion=reduce. Every flow rendered visible content (no blank screens) and every listed data-testid was found. Landing claim, Visitor Door (all 3 origins + drop-sent), Unclaimed-address claim -> Shelf, Owner unlock on /alex -> Shelf, all 6 Shelf nav sections, DropCard reply -> Stream conversion, Direct conversation open with stream-pin/mute/archive + message-fragments, Group creation + stream-invite -> invite-link/invite-copy, Channel creation with visibility+reply segmented controls, Search (Mara, Design) producing search-conv-* results and opening a stream, Settings sheet (name/tagline/prefs/save/forget), Lock returning to Door, and Theme toggle flipping the .dark class all worked.
critical_code_review_comments: Note (informational, not a bug): initial page-load screenshot in headless without reduced-motion can appear blank because entrance animations start at opacity:0 and rely on backdrop-filter. The app already ships a prefers-reduced-motion fallback which works correctly — no code change required, but consider ensuring the opacity:0 initial state animates in even when JS/CSS animations are delayed by slow paints (e.g., use animation-fill-mode:both plus a safety timeout that forces opacity:1 after ~1s). Testing agents/harnesses should emulate reduced-motion or wait 2-3s after nav.
test_credentials: No accounts. Any 4+ char password unlocks a claimed place in the mock (used 'secret'). Claim flow uses same rule.
seed_data_creation: None (used built-in seed places 'alex' and 'studio'; created a new place 'some-empty-place-xyz' during the unclaimed-claim test, and created a group 'Test Group' + channel 'Test Channel' inside /alex shelf).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL renders correctly in headless Chromium when prefers-reduced-motion is set to reduce (page.emulate_media(reduced_motion='reduce')) and a 2s post-navigation wait is used. All data-testids listed in the request are present and functional. localStorage keys are prefixed 'kodama-talk/v1' — clear before running claim-new-address flow to avoid state carry-over.
